description:
Published state-isolated Florida and California fishing evidence (state defaults to florida; California default species california-halibut): dated NOAA commercial catches and research/community occurrences, source/license credits, coordinate uncertainty, seasonal record counts and configurable 0.25/0.10/0.05/0.02/0.01/0.005-degree heatmap cells. Historical records are not live fish locations, migration tracks, abundance, catch rates or catch probabilities. Sampling/fishing effort is uncorrected; absent records do not establish fish absence. from/to are inclusive YYYY-MM-DD observation dates; month pools all selected years. state selects separate publications; species must belong to that state. Publication checks older than 26 hours are stale; query last-good times preserve partial outage age. California uses bounded OBIS/iNaturalist occurrences, not a comprehensive catch survey. Source check time is not observation time. Recency weighting defaults to recent: exponential 365-day half-life based on observation dates, not source retrieval. weighting=historical gives equal weights. No upstream downloads on tool calls.
Preserve species, observation dates, source credits, coordinate uncertainty, query coverage, partial/stale flags and fishing-effort bias. Heatmap color is record density, never fish abundance or catch odds. Commercial catches and occurrences must remain distinguishable. No generated migration paths.
Units: ft, kt, s, F, mi; directions FROM. Returns data and source/freshness metadata.
name: get_fishing_insights
title: Fishing evidence and seasonal summaries
